_comment: Spells out the plugin's defaults (with j6_limit_deg raised to 44 for followers that reach +-45): OpenArm 1.0 follower driven by an UNMODIFIED (2.0-order) KER. Channels pair each KER wrist axis with the follower axis pointing the same way; wrist_remap then re-solves J5-J7 so the hand orientation matches exactly. Fill in signs/offsets from single-axis dry runs, then verify handedness with a combined wrist pose.
